cards.title: BACK-ALLEY FIXER
cards.concept: street fixer in a worn grey bomber jacket over a grey checked flannel shirt, a cheap earpiece with one tiny cyan LED, a scuffed burner phone held up at his chest with a knowing half-smile.
cards.hook: Chief Business Officer and partnerships lead: in any district, the connection everyone needs runs through his earpiece.

cards.title: RACK HAULER
cards.concept: data-hall rack hauler in a grey utility jacket with padded shoulders and fingerless work gloves, a bare GPU server blade hugged flat against his chest.
cards.hook: Operations is in his bio, and in the compute world operations starts with getting the GPUs into the racks.

cards.title: LAUNCH COURIER
cards.concept: street courier in a padded grey jacket with a diagonal sling strap, a sealed hard-shell data case cuffed to his wrist and held at his chest.
cards.hook: He led product launches at Xsolla: the courier who gets the package to market on launch day.

cards.title: ARCADE BOUNCER
cards.concept: arcade door bouncer in a grey hoodie under a padded black vest, arms crossed, a lanyard with a round arcade-token badge hanging at his chest.
cards.hook: His tough-but-warm arms-crossed stance guarding the door of the games business he knows from Xsolla, a video-game commerce company.

cards.title: SCRAP APPRAISER
cards.concept: salvage-market appraiser in a grey work apron over a checked flannel shirt, sleeves rolled, turning a salvaged GPU chip between his fingers at chest height.
cards.hook: M&A is valuation work: before any acquisition, he knows exactly what the hardware is worth.

cards.title: DILIGENCE RUNNER
cards.concept: netrunner in charcoal techwear with green terminal-code stripes, a small green-lit implant on his temple, a compact cyberdeck held at his chest with a data cable looping up to the implant.
cards.hook: He led acquisitions at Xsolla: before any deal closes, he dives deep into the target's data.

cards.title: PIPELINE HACKER
cards.concept: sales-ops techie in a grey hoodie with green piping, arms crossed, a wrist display on his forearm projecting a small rising green bar chart.
cards.hook: Sales is in his bio: he hacks the pipeline until every number turns terminal green.

cards.title: DRONE FOREMAN
cards.concept: data-centre ops foreman in a green-trimmed utility vest and a headset mic, a small maintenance drone with one cyan lens hovering beside his shoulder.
cards.hook: An operations leader: he directs the swarm that keeps the whole data hall humming.

cards.title: TEAM ARCHITECT
cards.concept: techie builder in a green-striped tech jacket with a tiny implant on the back of his hand, snapping two glowing green circuit modules together at his chest.
cards.hook: At Xsolla he stood up new departments from scratch, snapping teams together like modules.

cards.title: THE CLOSER
cards.concept: street samurai in a sleek black armoured jacket with glowing teal seams, a cyan holo-katana held upright in front of one shoulder, calm confident half-smile.
cards.hook: Chief Business Officer and sales leader: the closer who cuts cleanly through any negotiation.

cards.title: HYPERSCALER
cards.concept: overclocker in a teal-seamed armoured jacket, one forearm sheathed in a chunky GPU gauntlet with cooling fins raised at his chest, its fans glowing faint cyan.
cards.hook: He scales high-growth companies: a hyperscaler in the most literal sense, with GPU power strapped to his arm.

cards.title: ACQUISITION AGENT
cards.concept: corporate acquisitions operative in a long charcoal coat with teal-lit seams and a high collar, a slim earpiece, holding a glowing cyan data spike, the signed deal, at his chest.
cards.hook: M&A is his trade, from the acquisitions he led at Xsolla to every deal since.

cards.title: CHROME EXECUTIVE
cards.concept: chrome-augmented corpo exec in a sharp dark suit with polished chrome shoulder plates and chrome hands, arms crossed, a violet holographic skyline of simple glowing towers rising behind his shoulders with hot-pink neon edging the suit.
cards.hook: He builds new departments and scales high-growth companies: every tower in the skyline behind him is one he raised.

cards.title: TOKEN TYCOON
cards.concept: on-chain magnate in a chrome-plated violet armoured coat, holding a glowing magenta hexagonal token at his chest, a large violet holographic GPU chip floating behind his shoulders shedding a few bold magenta tokens.
cards.hook: Compute Labs turns GPUs into on-chain tokens, and as Chief Business Officer he is the one who brings them to market.

cards.title: SOVEREIGN OF SCALE
cards.concept: ascended compute sovereign in gold-and-white chrome regalia with a high circuit-etched collar, arms crossed in his signature stance, a halo ring of glowing golden GPU cores high behind his head, faint cyan circuit lines through the gold and a radiant golden aura around his silhouette.
cards.hook: His ultimate form as the builder and scaler of high-growth companies: every partnership, acquisition and launch fused into one golden compute empire.
